baslik: Castle Bravo: The Bomb That Came Out 2.5 Times Too Big

sahneler.metin: The fireball grew four miles wide in about a second.
Castle Bravo is still the largest bomb America ever tested.
So how was the math off by that much?
Lithium-7. Physicists assumed it was inert. It became extra fuel.
Fallout rained on islands and a Japanese fishing boat far away.
Its crew fell sick, and one man later died.
One wrong assumption, two and a half times the power.

aciklama:
On March 1, 1954, Castle Bravo yielded 15 megatons instead of the expected 6. Lithium-7, assumed inert, joined the reaction.
